_readme: Component registry (source of truth for tools/style-gate.cjs, rule A2.1). One role = ONE component class. A new class for a role that is already here is forbidden; a new role = new entry here + a question to the customer (questions/qa.py ask). Sources: design-system.md (tables 'Компоненти: єдине визначення', 'Кнопки: hover', 'Картка') and src/styles/**. BEM children (`<root>__x`) of a registered root are accepted automatically; modifiers (`<root>--x`) must be listed explicitly. Only the style-gate reads this file; do not add classes here to silence the gate without a customer decision.

kinds._note: kind = how the gate recognises an element by LOOK (not by class): 'button' = clickable AND (filled / bordered / pill); 'card' = filled or bordered surface with radius >= 4 and size >= 120x72. An element of that kind MUST carry a class of a role of the same kind (or of kind 'chrome').

button.description: Every button-like clickable. Hover = disc from the centre (buttons.css DISC block, gate: npm run audit:hover).

icon-ring.description: Icon in a circle. decor (no modifier) = non-clickable; --action = filled clickable ring (mail/phone, header phone); --on-accent = on the blue surface. Clickable ancestor without --action / --action without clickable ancestor = A1.3.

decorInLink.note: Home Products: decorative ring inside a whole-card link (trust-audit A.1): needs a customer decision (WARN until decided).

nav-pill.description: Header / burger navigation items (no fill at rest, disc on hover).

lang-switch.description: Language dropdown trigger and its rows (.lang-menu__option, one mechanic).

chip.description: Category chip / tag; .chip--tag is a non-clickable tag inside a card link.

filter.description: Catalog filter items / toggle and pagination controls.

text-card.description: Text card (eyebrow + h2 + p + one button). Surface by modifier: on-accent (blue) / on-light; compact (Catalog help + empty, no h2). Internal gaps = --text-card-gap 30.

quality-card.description: Illustration card (icon-ring + art slot + h3 + p) on Home/About Quality.

link-card.description: Whole-card link (icon-ring + h3 + p), Home Products / Services categories.

service-item.description: The 4 services (Manufacturer search / Regulatory / Samples / Specs). TARGET: ONE class for Home, About, Services. Today two: how-step, svc-card (+ .svc-card--on-accent on the blue About section) (pendingMerge: WARN while more than one is in use).

card.description: Base card + special cards built on it (list cards on light pages = filled tiles, no border: design-system.md 'Поверхня картки').

heading-group.description: Eyebrow > h2 > description > CTA = ONE wrapper .section-head (gap 24 between every pair). Local '*__head' wrappers are allowed ONLY together with .section-head (mustAlsoMatch).

mustAlsoMatch.note: local *__head wrapper without .section-head = new heading-group component

field.description: Form field: label above, 16 px label->control gap on every form (--field-label-gap); search = pill variant.

hero.description: Hero: .hero--home (the only gradient on the site) and inner-page hero (.hero__head = .section-head: tag > h1 > sub > CTA, + .hero__media).

art-slot.description: Illustration slot in a card (3D point+line scene on the shared engine src/utils/il-scene.js, no dashes, no fat lines). TARGET: ONE slot class. Today 7 (pendingMerge). Any NEW *__art class = FAIL.

contact-row.description: Contact row (footer / contact page): ALWAYS a filled .icon-ring--action + text; fax must not reuse the phone icon as a tel: link (customer 2026-11-12).

page-chrome.description: Header panel, footer, breadcrumbs, legal blocks, slides, photo panels and other layout containers (not components of their own: they may look like surfaces).

removedClasses._note: Deleted by customer decision: must not exist in the DOM (FAIL).

deprecatedClasses._note: No longer used on pages (trust-audit A.2): WARN if present, remove from CSS with the next cleanup.

ignoreCardLike._note: Selectors never treated as an unregistered card/button by the heuristic (layout wrappers, media frames, controls with their own spec).

_cardContainersNote: Skipped by card surface (B) and row (A7) checks: list wrappers and ruled list steps (how-step).
_renderersNote: Free scenes / backgrounds with their own WebGLRenderer by design (customer-confirmed via coordinator 2026-11-13; architectural exception, not a style one). Any NEW renderer file outside this list and il-scene.js = FAIL.
_animatedNote: Elements whose colour is animated by scroll (text fill): any alpha of the token base colour (--c-white / --text-on-accent / --accent-contrast) is allowed for A5.1. Architectural rule, not a customer signature.
